Financing activities

The Financing Activities screen allows you to create and manage groups for categorizing cash flows in the cash flow statement.

Financing activities represent cash flows between your business and its owners or lenders, showing how the business is funded.

Overview

Financing activities include transactions that affect the long-term liabilities and equity of your business. Common examples include:

• Receiving cash from loans or issuing bonds

• Repaying loan principal amounts

• Receiving cash from issuing shares or capital contributions

• Paying dividends or making drawings to owners

Setting Up Groups

Click the New Group button to create custom groups that match your business's financing structure.

Each group you create will appear as a separate line item in the financing activities section of your cash flow statement.

Groups help organize similar financing transactions together for clearer financial reporting.

Name
Name

Displays the name of each financing activity group that you have created.

Group names should be descriptive to help identify the type of financing transactions they contain.
